identity.description: Set the handle type for the control points of a Bézier curve

enum_items.name: Free
enum_items.description: The handle can be moved anywhere, and doesn't influence the point's other handle

enum_items.name: Auto
enum_items.description: The location is automatically calculated to be smooth

enum_items.name: Vector
enum_items.description: The location is calculated to point to the next/previous control point

enum_items.name: Align
enum_items.description: The location is constrained to point in the opposite direction as the other handle
